$comment: Shipped-bundle budgets in KiB -- see scripts/bundle-budget-gate.mjs.
Unlike quality-baseline.json these are NOT auto-recorded: a bundle may
legitimately grow when a feature lands, so raising a number must be a
deliberate line in a diff with a reason, not a regenerated file.
Seeded from the 2026-09-03 build with roughly 5% headroom.

note: The installable offline PWA (ADR 0090). Its service worker precaches
every byte counted in `total`, so this is what a device downloads on
install, once, over whatever connection it has.
83% of that total is one file: the client-core Wasm sync engine at
~12.5 MiB. It dominates `total` and `largestAsset` while contributing
nothing to `javascriptGzip`, which is why both are budgeted -- a JS
regression would be invisible inside a 15 MiB total.
